name: robinhood-wallet-tracker
description: Node.js wallet tracker bot for Robinhood Chain (EVM L2) using Alchemy API and ethers.js v6

scripts.alerts: bash -c 'curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-3000}/alerts | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null || curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-3000}/alerts'
scripts.balances: bash -c 'curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-3000}/balances | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null || curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-3000}/balances'
